approaches_tried.approach: Design common_test_workdir_init to both set the caller's $WORKDIR and echo it for $(...) capture
approaches_tried.reason: Command substitution runs the function in its own subshell; the EXIT trap installed inside the function fires on that subshell's exit (deleting the directory) before the outer assignment ever reads the echoed value. Fixed by removing the echo and documenting 'call as a bare statement, never via $(...)' in both the function header and the regression test.

approaches_tried.approach: Detect test-helper redefinition in fixtures that source common.sh via an indirected $COMMON_LIB_PATH env var
approaches_tried.reason: The detector's grep probe (source.*common\.sh) requires the literal substring 'common.sh' on the source line; a variable reference doesn't contain it. Fixed by building both fixtures with an unquoted heredoc so $LIB (this suite's own resolved path) expands to a literal path at fixture-write time.

deviations.reason: scripts/lib/common.sh already defined common_test_pass/_fail/_info (unused by any suite) and common_repo_root; extending it with the three genuinely-missing pieces avoids a second, parallel, partially-redundant library.
